comment: Single source of truth for the music score and the SFX track on the 300s Ep19 timeline (Saudi Arabia vs Uruguay). This episode is IMAGE-BASED (Ken-Burns motion on player stills) - there are NO generated video clips, so the `clips` array is empty. mux.mjs mixes the music cues (looped/trimmed, ducked under Brian's VO) and any ElevenLabs sound-design hits in sfx/ (skipped gracefully if not yet generated). Music plan per README: Crossing the Chasm, Five Armies, Desert City, Invariance - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC-BY 4.0.

music.comment: Four-cue film score. Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC-BY 4.0 - credit required in the YouTube description (see README). The Ghost-of-the-Maracana mystery segment (~261-280) deliberately drops the heavy bed: only the heroic cue swells under Brian.

sfx.comment: ElevenLabs sound-design hits (sfx/*.mp3). Generated alongside the VO; mux.mjs skips any that are missing, so the NO_VO music preview still works before they exist. Whooshes ride the scene transitions; the rest mark story beats. Goals: Al-Dawsari ~201, Nunez ~221, Araujo ~231; full-time whistle ~241.
